# Tests of Auditor's sidecar that are EXPECTED to fail against this branch:
# breaks made on purpose, each waiting for the consumer to follow.
#
#   module.path::test_name  # reason, and where the change is described
#
# scripts/consumer_canary.py fails the check on any failure NOT listed here,
# and warns when a line here passes again — then the line is removed.
# Do not add a line to make a red check green: add it when the break is
# intended, written in the changelog, and the consumer has been told.

tests.test_sessions::test_an_empty_file_read_against_an_anchor_is_a_deleted_log  # an empty container without an anchor has the verdict "empty" since report /2; the test expects "partial" — docs/specs/report/MIGRATING-1-TO-2.md
